patch_description: The current greedy assigns each model to the GPU with the lowest current load/free-mem ratio, but the correct objective is the resulting KVPR after placement: (load + w) / (GPU_MEM_SIZE - (free - size)). Selecting the GPU that directly minimizes the post-placement KVPR gives a strictly better greedy. On top of that, add a local-search pass that repeatedly moves a model off the GPU with maximum KVPR to another GPU whenever it reduces the global maximum KVPR. This mimics the well-known "minimize makespan via LPT + local improvement" strategy: greedy seeding plus move-based refinement drives the maximum KVPR down toward the optimal balanced partition.
